HowItWorksPage.title: How It Works
HowItWorksPage.subtitle: With GötürBeni, sharing an intercity ride is completed in four steps.

search.title: Search for your ride
search.description: Choose your departure, destination, and date; filter by map or GPS location to instantly see active listings that match. As a passenger, search for a seat; as a driver, list your open seats.

book.title: Book your seat
book.description: Once the driver approves your booking request, your trip is confirmed. No payment is made at this stage — the full fare is paid after the trip is completed.

pickup.title: Get in touch with your driver
pickup.description: Work out the meeting details through in-app chat and track the driver's live location. At pickup, the passenger just tells the driver their 4-digit verification code — that's how the trip officially starts.

complete.title: Finish the trip, leave a review
complete.description: After the trip is completed, the passenger sends the full fare to the driver's IBAN and uploads the receipt; both sides rate each other with 1–5 stars and a comment — these reviews appear on each user's profile.

trust.title: Trusted profiles
trust.description: Every user has a profile with a history of past trips and mutual star ratings and reviews, so you can see who you're traveling with. You'll need to verify your account, and if you're a driver, add a valid license plate.

help.title: Need help?
help.description: Check out our Support page for frequently asked questions, or email us directly.

SupportPage.title: Support
SupportPage.subtitle: Frequently asked questions and what you need to know about how the platform works.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: If you couldn't find the answer you were looking for below, email us directly and we'll get back to you as quickly as we can.

booking.question: How does booking work?
booking.answer: You send a seat request on a listing; the request goes to the driver as 'Pending.' If the driver approves it, your booking is confirmed; if declined, the seat isn't affected.

cancellation.question: Can I cancel my booking or listing?
cancellation.answer: Yes. Passengers can cancel a pending or approved booking from the 'My Bookings' page; drivers can cancel their own listing from the 'My Rides' page.

payment.question: How does payment work?
payment.answer: GötürBeni doesn't take a commission. Approving a booking doesn't require any payment — once the ride is completed, you send the full fare to the IBAN shown on the driver's profile and upload the receipt through the app; once it's reviewed and approved, the payment is considered complete.

depositRejected.question: What happens if my uploaded receipt is rejected?
depositRejected.answer: You'll be shown the reason for the rejection, and you can fix the issue and upload a new receipt for the same booking.

waitlist.question: What can I do if a listing is full?
waitlist.answer: On a listing that shows as full, you can join the waitlist using 'Notify Me When a Seat Opens Up'; you'll get a notification if a seat is cancelled or opens up.

safety.question: What's being done for safety?
safety.answer: Every account is verified with a code sent to its email address at registration. Before payment, you can see the driver's member-since date, number of completed trips, and rating. Our system automatically detects and reviews suspicious accounts and listings using automated rules.

femaleDriver.question: How does the Female Driver filter work?
femaleDriver.answer: Users who have set their gender as female on their profile can limit search results to listings from female drivers only. A driver's gender isn't public; this filter only returns results for users who have themselves declared they are female.

pickupCode.question: What is the pickup verification code?
pickupCode.answer: A unique 4-digit code is generated for you once your booking is approved. When you meet the driver, you tell them this code; once the driver enters it in the app, your trip is considered started.

dispute.question: What should I do if I have a dispute with a driver or passenger?
dispute.answer: You can open a dispute from the relevant booking using the 'Report a Problem' option; our team will review your request and let you know the outcome.

suspendedAccount.question: Why might my account be suspended?
suspendedAccount.answer: Accounts showing suspicious behavior or violating the rules may be suspended by an administrator. A suspended account cannot post new listings, make bookings, send messages, or leave reviews.

carPlate.question: Why do you ask for a license plate?
carPlate.answer: To post listings as a driver, you need to add a license plate in a valid format to your profile. This information is shown publicly on listing and profile pages so passengers can recognize the correct vehicle at the meeting point.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern the rules that apply to drivers and passengers using the GötürBeni platform (“Platform”). By using the Platform, you are deemed to have accepted these terms.

service.heading: Description of the Service
body: GötürBeni is a matching platform that connects car-owning drivers with passengers who want to travel the same route on intercity trips.
The Platform is not a taxi operator, commercial passenger transport company, or travel agency; drivers arrange trips using their own vehicles on a cost-sharing basis.
This platform strictly prohibits commercial transport services. Drivers may only share travel costs; accounts found to be operating for profit will be suspended or closed.
The Platform does not currently charge any commission or service fee on trips.

obligations.heading: User Obligations
body: By registering on the Platform, you confirm that the name, email, phone number, and other profile information you provide are accurate, current, and belong to you.
The following behaviors are prohibited:
items: Arranging trips for commercial purposes or profit, or reselling seats to third parties — accounts found doing so will be suspended or closed
Using false, misleading, or another person's identity or contact information
Engaging in harassment, discrimination, or threatening behavior toward other users
Using the Platform for purposes other than its intended use (advertising, spam, fraud, etc.)

booking.heading: Booking and Cancellation Policy
body: Passengers submit seat requests on a ride listing; the driver may approve or decline the request. An approved booking may be cancelled by either the driver or the passenger before the trip takes place.

The Platform is not a payment institution and does not hold funds at any stage. The cost of the trip is shared via direct bank transfer to the driver's IBAN; the passenger uploads the transfer receipt to the system, and the driver — and the Platform when necessary — reviews this receipt to confirm the payment was made.

If a driver cancels a booking for which payment has already been received, the Platform automatically initiates a refund process; the driver is expected to upload a receipt showing the refund was made, and this refund is reviewed by the Platform.

The Platform is not a party to cost-sharing disputes between users; the receipt review process described above is an oversight convenience and does not guarantee that payment has actually taken place.

liability.heading: Limitation of Liability
body: GötürBeni is solely an intermediary platform that connects drivers and passengers; it is not a party to the travel arrangement formed between them.
The Platform cannot be held responsible for drivers' vehicle use, compliance with traffic rules, insurance obligations, or conduct during the trip, nor for passengers' conduct.

The Platform bears no legal responsibility for accidents, delays, loss of property or life, or other damages that may occur during trips between users. Users take part in trips voluntarily and at their own risk.

termination.heading: Account Suspension and Termination
body: In the event of a breach of these terms, a safety concern, or complaints from other users, GötürBeni reserves the right to temporarily suspend or permanently close an account, with or without prior notice.
Users may close their accounts at any time.

disputes.heading: Dispute Resolution and Governing Law
body: These Terms of Use are governed by the laws of the Republic of Turkey. Turkish courts and enforcement offices have jurisdiction over any disputes arising from these terms.
For disputes between users, we recommend first attempting an amicable resolution.

contact.heading: Contact
body: For questions about these Terms of Use, you can reach us at novarodigitalstudio@gmail.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data is collected when you use the GötürBeni platform, how it is used, and what your rights are.

dataCollected.heading: Data We Collect
body: When you register on the Platform and use it, we process the following personal data:
items: Identity and contact information: full name, email address, phone number
Profile information: profile photo, short bio
Trip data: departure and arrival city, date, seat count, cost share amount
Communication data: messages sent within the app between driver and passenger
Rating data: ratings and reviews you give to or receive from other users

purposes.heading: Purposes of Processing
body: Your personal data is processed for the following purposes:
items: Creating, approving, and managing booking requests
Enabling communication between driver and passenger
Operating the rating/review system to ensure user trust and platform safety
Creating and managing your account

storage.heading: Data Storage
body: Your data is hosted on our infrastructure provider, Supabase. Supabase's servers may be located outside Turkey, in which case your data is transferred abroad. This is explicitly disclosed here as an international data transfer.
Your data is protected with industry-standard security measures (encrypted connections, access control).

retention.heading: Retention Period
body: Your personal data is retained for as long as your account is active and for as long as required by the purposes stated above. When you delete your account, your data is deleted or anonymized within a reasonable period, subject to legal retention obligations.

rights.heading: Your Rights
body: You have the right to learn whether your personal data is being processed, to request access to your data, to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data, and, where permitted by law, to request deletion of your data.
For users based in Turkey, you can find the full list of your rights under KVKK (Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law) on the /kvkk page.

cookies.heading: Cookies
body: The Platform uses a cookie named NEXT_LOCALE to remember your language preference, and Supabase authentication cookies to keep you signed in.
The Platform does not use any analytics or advertising cookies.

contact.heading: Contact
body: For questions about our privacy practices, you can reach us at novarodigitalstudio@gmail.com.

kvkk.title: KVKK Notice (Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law)
kvkk.intro: This Disclosure Notice has been prepared to inform you about your personal data processed by the GötürBeni platform, in accordance with Article 10 of Turkish Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data (“KVKK”).

controller.heading: Identity of the Data Controller
body: Your personal data is processed by Ahmed Alsalem as the data controller, for the purposes and within the scope described below. GötürBeni is operated as an individual (sole natural person) activity and has no separate corporate entity (company); accordingly, it has no MERSIS registration.
Contact: novarodigitalstudio@gmail.com

categories.heading: Categories of Personal Data Processed
body: The following categories of your personal data are processed through the Platform:
items: Identity data: first name, last name
Contact data: email address, phone number
Location/travel data: departure and arrival city, trip date, seat count, cost share amount
Transaction security data: account creation and login records, IP address, and similar technical access information

purposes.heading: Purposes of Processing Personal Data
body: Your personal data is processed for the purposes of managing membership and accounts, carrying out trip booking processes (request, approval, rejection, cancellation), enabling communication between driver and passenger, ensuring user and platform safety, and operating the rating/review system.

legalBasis.heading: Legal Basis for Processing Personal Data
body: Your personal data is processed on the legal grounds set out in Article 5/2 of the KVKK: that “processing is necessary for the establishment or performance of a contract, provided it is directly related to the parties to the contract,” and that “processing is necessary for the legitimate interests of the data controller, provided this does not harm the fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject.”

collectionMethod.heading: Method of Collecting Personal Data
body: Your personal data is collected electronically and automatically, through information you provide directly via the GötürBeni web application during registration, profile editing, ride listing creation, booking, and messaging.

transfer.heading: Transfer of Personal Data
body: Your personal data is hosted on Supabase, which provides the Platform's technical infrastructure. Since Supabase's server infrastructure may be located outside Turkey, your personal data may be transferred abroad under Article 9 of the KVKK.

This transfer is carried out in accordance with the conditions set out in Article 9 of the KVKK (explicit consent, transfer to countries deemed by the Personal Data Protection Board to provide adequate protection, or adequate protection ensured through a written undertaking).

rights.heading: Your Rights Under Article 11 of the KVKK
body: Under Article 11 of the KVKK, everyone has the right to apply to the data controller and request the following regarding themselves:
items: To learn whether their personal data is being processed
To request information about it if their personal data has been processed
To learn the purpose for which their personal data is processed and whether it is used in accordance with that purpose
To know the third parties, domestic or foreign, to whom their personal data is transferred
To request correction of personal data that has been processed incompletely or incorrectly
To request deletion or destruction of personal data within the conditions set out in Article 7 of the KVKK
To request that any correction or deletion/destruction be notified to third parties to whom the personal data has been transferred
To object to a result that is to their detriment arising from the analysis of processed data exclusively through automated systems
To request compensation for damages suffered due to unlawful processing of personal data

application.heading: How to Apply
body: To exercise the rights listed above, you may submit your request, along with identity-verifying documents, via novarodigitalstudio@gmail.com using a secure electronic signature, mobile signature, or the email address you previously registered with the data controller and that is on file in our system.

Your application will be concluded free of charge within 30 days at the latest, in accordance with Article 13 of the KVKK; however, if the process requires an additional cost, a fee may be charged according to the tariff set by the Personal Data Protection Board.
